title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg and Chilli
summary: Creamy avocado on crisp toast topped with a silky poached egg and a fresh chilli kick. It makes a quick, satisfying vegetarian breakfast with plenty of flavour and texture.
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Halve the avocado, remove the stone, and mash the flesh with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper until mostly smooth but still a little chunky.
Bring a small saucepan of water to a gentle simmer. Crack each egg into a small cup, then slide them into the water and poach for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft.
Spread the avocado mixture over the toast.
Top each slice with a poached egg, then finish with sliced chilli and an extra pinch of black pepper if you like.
